meaning.intent: read back the authority document the current model installed for one capability
meaning.outcome: the caller observes the installed sidefx-capability-authority.v1 document and its content address, or that no document is installed for the id

scenarios.name: Read the authority document installed for one capability
scenarios.given: one capability identity and the current model
scenarios.when: the installed capability document ledger is read under the reader boundary
scenarios.then: the installed authority document and its content address are returned, or the caller is told no document is installed for the id
